fusion_ranked_evidence.title: Justice Dinesh Kumar Singh Sworn In As Judge Of Kerala High Court
fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: Justice Dinesh Kumar Singh was sworn in as a Judge of the Kerala High Court today. Justice Singh has been transferred from the Allahabad High Court.

fusion_ranked_evidence.title: Justice Dinesh Kumar Singh Sworn In As Kerala HC Judge
fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: Justice Dinesh Kumar Singh on Friday sworn in as a Judge of the Kerala High Court #Justicedineshkumarsingh #judge #keralahighcourt #legally

fusion_ranked_evidence.title: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Dinesh Kumar Singh
fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: Appointed as Additional Judge on Sep 22, 2017. Took oath as Permanent Judge on Sep 06, 2019. Took oath as Judge of Kerala High Court on 21.07.2023.
